verdict.rationale: Floot's only programmatic surface is its own remote MCP server (OAuth2, streamable-http, registered in the MCP registry). It exposes tools for building and shipping apps, reading logs, running SQL and creating checkpoints, so apps can be generated and managed programmatically through an AI client. There is no OpenAPI document, no documented REST API, no interactive reference, no sandbox and no versioning, which limits it as a general platform API. Missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP platform API with OpenAPI spec, explicit app create/list/delete/publish endpoints, versioning/changelog, sandbox, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API
